string.name: privacy_policy
string.value:
Privacy policy · October 10, 2026
Game of Life by LazyJazzDev works offline, without accounts, ads or analytics.
Optional icon rotation: only after you agree, the app subscribes to HarmonyOS gravity sensor readings (x/y/z gravity components; x and y are used) at a requested interval of 200 ms, while the game is visible in the foreground. Readings turn the button icons with the device; they are processed immediately on this device, never saved, uploaded, shared or used for identification or advertising.
Declining leaves the icons fixed and does not affect playing, editing or saving patterns. You can withdraw consent here at any time; reading stops on disabling or leaving the foreground. Your choice is saved locally.
Saved patterns stay in this app's storage; the system file picker accesses only files you select. No camera, microphone, location, contacts or network permission is requested. No third-party tracking SDKs are used. These practices apply to users of all ages.
Full policy: https://lazyjazzdev.github.io/Game-of-Life-Mobile/privacy/
Contact: https://github.com/LazyJazzDev/Game-of-Life-Mobile/issues
